proxy_host.description: Hostname or IP of the local HTTP/HTTPS proxy (-p host)

proxy_port.description: Port of the local HTTP/HTTPS proxy (-p :port)

dest_host.description: Hostname or IP of the final destination (-d host)

rem_proxy_host.description: Hostname or IP of the remote/secondary proxy (-r host)

proxy_user.description: Username for local proxy authentication (-P username)

rem_proxy_user.description: Username for remote proxy authentication (-R username)

encrypt_to_dest.description: Enable SSL encryption between local proxy and destination (-e)

encrypt_to_proxy.description: Enable SSL encryption between client and local proxy (-E)

encrypt_to_rem_proxy.description: Enable SSL encryption between local and remote proxy (-X)

check_cert.description: Verify server SSL certificates. If false, uses -z (--no-check-certificate)

ca_cert_file.description: Path to CA certificate file or directory for verification (-C filename)

force_ipv4.description: Enforce IPv4 for local proxy connection (-4)

force_ipv6.description: Enforce IPv6 for local proxy connection (-6)

standalone_enabled.description: Run as standalone daemon instead of connecting directly. Requires -a (--standalone)

standalone_addr.description: Address to bind for standalone daemon. Empty string means any address.

standalone_port.description: Port to bind for standalone daemon.

additional_headers.description: List of custom HTTP headers to send to the proxy (-H 'Header: Value'). Items are flat strings.
